summary: Reproduced all three remaining counterexamples from review https://github.com/amdpilot-org/FlyDSL/pull/575 against candidate https://github.com/amdpilot-org/FlyDSL/pull/573 at f3176f6a51dcc480298ee7d8779319d736db865f, preserved the candidate's valid structural checks, and completed the slice. Static TileType logical_divide divisibility is now checked, complement rejects non-congruent layout structure before algebra helpers can assert, and left_inverse rejects statically non-invertible layouts. Dynamic profiles remain accepted when values are not statically knowable.

tests.what_was_measured: Pinned-LLVM candidate native build and real FlyDSL vector-add GPU smoke before correction.
Failing-before: the candidate accepted a static TileType divisor of size 6 for a size-16 layout.
Failing-before: complement aborted at intTupleFilterZero on non-congruent shape/stride tuple ranks.
Failing-before: left_inverse accepted the statically non-invertible layout and inferred (2,32):(0,1).
Pinned-LLVM corrected native build, rebuilt-native import switch, and real FlyDSL vector-add GPU smoke.
Passing-after regression: all candidate and review counterexamples emitted expected operation diagnostics; legal dynamic-layout controls remained accepted.

tests.command: every RUN line in tests/mlir/LayoutAlgebra/*.mlir using rebuilt fly-opt and pinned LLVM FileCheck
tests.what_was_measured: All 11 LayoutAlgebra files passed against the corrected rebuilt compiler, including layout lowering coverage.

tests.command: corrected rebuilt fly-opt on each of /job/evidence-j-7a3588bfe797/adversarial-{tile-divide,complement,left-inverse}.mlir
tests.what_was_measured: Each formerly accepted/crashing standalone input now exits with a targeted diagnostic; complement no longer aborts.

gpu_evidence: Both candidate and corrected pinned-LLVM rebuilds passed FlyDSL vector_add 100x1000 on exactly one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), with Torch 2.9.1+rocm7.2.0.git7e1940d4 and HIP 7.2.26015-fc0010cf6a. This establishes rebuilt-library operation, not verifier completeness.
remaining_limitations: Static verification sees type profiles only. Divisibility, congruence-adjacent value relationships, composition bounds, and invertibility that depend on dynamic SSA values remain runtime concerns unless runtime checks are added. Validation used the assigned gfx950 GPU only; verifier behavior itself is architecture-independent and was tested directly with rebuilt fly-opt. No LLVM change was required. Raw inputs and logs are retained under /job/evidence-j-7a3588bfe797, and native build metadata is retained at /job/native-build.json.
